after_quest_completed:quest_chop_wood: Good work. Water and wood both sorted - the forge is running again.
Now get out there and make yourself useful. Those wolves won't cull themselves.
after_quest_completed:quest_fetch_water: Water's in, good. Now we need fuel for the fire.
Chop some logs from the trees out back and process them into planks at the forge.
requires_background:background_blacksmit: Ah, there you are kid. We need to stay productive.
The well is dried up and we need water for quenching. Grab the bucket and head to the river.
Then chop some wood. We need logs to turn into planks.
Oh, and wolves have been raiding the livestock at night. Cull 5 of them when you get the chance.
default: Welcome to the forge. I buy pelts and tusks - sell me what you find.
Need gear? I've got axes, armour, and potions. Gold talks.

dialogOptions.label: What have you got for sale?

after_quest_completed:quest_cull_wolves: Fewer wolves means I can gather herbs without watching my back.
My stock is fuller for it. Come see me when you need patching up.
requires_background:background_blacksmit: Your father used to send metal scraps my way for the herb press.
I've kept a few bandages aside for his family. Take what you need.
default: Potions and bandages - everything you need to keep breathing out there.
The wilderness takes a toll. Come back in one piece and I'll keep you patched up.

after_quest_completed:quest_cull_wolves: With those wolves gone the trade roads might open up again.
I'll have more stock coming in soon. Buy what I've got for now.
requires_background:background_blacksmit: The blacksmith's own kid. Your father kept my cart rolling more than once.
Good steel for a fair price - that's how we do business.
default: Blades, shields, and mail - everything the well-prepared adventurer carries.
I buy quality gear too. Find something good out there, bring it back.

requires_background:background_blacksmit: Ah, the smith's kid! How is your father?
